encoding: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, separators (',', ':'), no trailing newline; the response files are the exact bytes the server sends

cases.name: minimal
cases.description: Two anchored issues with suggestions and one source-only issue; context and one precedent in the request.

cases.name: dropped-unanchored
cases.description: Complete review where three model issues could not be anchored and were dropped.

cases.name: not-reviewed
cases.description: The model output failed validation: status not_reviewed, nothing checked, no issues.

cases.name: issue-limit
cases.description: Twenty small issues: sorted by confidence then position, sixteen kept, four omitted (issue_limit).

cases.name: suggestion-span-too-long
cases.description: A 300-scalar executable range: the issue and its complete span stay, the suggestion and alternatives are withheld (span_too_long).

cases.name: suggestion-replacement-too-long
cases.description: A 241-scalar replacement: the suggestion is withheld (replacement_too_long); the span is complete.

cases.name: suggestion-boundary
cases.description: Exactly 200 scalars of range with exactly 240 scalars of replacement and alternative: kept.

cases.name: byte-limit
cases.description: Four issues spanning both whole 2,000-scalar sides with escape-heavy text: three fit the byte budget, the fourth is omitted whole (byte_limit). The spans are never shortened.

cases.name: max
cases.description: The largest legal response the fixtures carry: its final serialized size, counters included, is within 1 KiB below the 57,344-byte budget, one more issue would exceed it, and omitted_issues has two digits.

cases.name: near-limit-request
cases.description: A valid request at every scalar limit whose compact UTF-8 encoding is just under the 32 KiB request limit.
